successCriteria.description: Employee interface is defined in `src/modules/employee/employee.model.ts` with all 13 fields: id, employeeNumber, firstName, lastName, email, managerId, department, hireDate, terminationDate, employmentStatus, createdAt, updatedAt, deletedAt — each with the correct TypeScript type as specified

IEmployeeRepository interface extends IBaseRepository<Employee> and declares four additional methods: findByEmployeeNumber(employeeNumber: string): Promise<Employee | null>, findByEmail(email: string): Promise<Employee | null>, findByManagerId(managerId: string): Promise<Employee[]>, findActive(): Promise<Employee[]>

EmployeeRepository class implements IEmployeeRepository, imports the pg pool from `src/shared/db/connection.ts`, and uses parameterized SQL queries (no string concatenation) for all database operations
Unit tests in `tests/unit/modules/employee/employee.repository.spec.ts` use a mocked pg pool and cover at minimum: findById, findByEmployeeNumber, findByEmail, create, and update
EmploymentStatus is imported from `src/shared/types/index.ts` (not redefined locally) and used as the type for the employmentStatus field

constraints: All database access must go through the repository pattern (GP-001) — EmployeeRepository is the sole gateway to the employees table
All SQL queries must use parameterized queries ($1, $2, ...) — no string concatenation or template literal interpolation for SQL values
No circular dependencies — employee module must not import from other domain modules (leave, balance, policy, notification)
Use `unknown` with type guards instead of `any` (HARNESS.json constraint: no-any)
No hardcoded secrets, passwords, API keys, or tokens (HARNESS.json constraint: no-hardcoded-secrets)
outOfScope: Employee service, controller, or routes — these are deferred to later phases (the intent only covers model + repository)
Database migrations for the employees table — deferred to Phase 10
Audit record creation (GP-002) — this phase defines the model and repository only; no state-changing operations are invoked at runtime yet
RBAC enforcement (GP-005) and input validation (GP-003) — no API endpoints exist in this phase

ambiguities.description: The `src/shared/db/connection.ts` file exports a raw `pg` Pool, but ARCHITECTURE.md describes the database layer as "Knex". The intent explicitly says to use "the pg pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts", so the raw pg driver is authoritative for this phase. If Knex is later introduced, the repository may need refactoring.
options: Use raw pg Pool as the connection.ts file currently exports
Switch connection.ts to Knex and use Knex query builder in the repository

ambiguities.description: The IEmployeeRepository extends IBaseRepository<Employee>, which requires implementing findAll, create, update, delete, and findById. The test spec only explicitly covers findById, findByEmployeeNumber, findByEmail, create, and update — leaving findAll, delete, findByManagerId, and findActive untested. The interface contract requires all methods to be implemented, but the test coverage is partial.
options: Implement all IBaseRepository methods plus the four additional methods, even if not all are tested
Only implement the methods explicitly listed in the test spec
